## ADM Final Assignment

For visualising the testing results

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

df <- read.csv("results.csv")

g1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = L, y = blocking_pairs, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point()

g2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = L, y = avg_rank, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point()

g3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = L, y = avg_distance, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point()

g4 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = L, y = matched_rate, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point()

g1
g2
g3
g4
```

Stacked plots
```{r}
g1/f1

```

```{r}
newdf <- df[ which(df[,5]>0.75

n1 <- ggplot(newdf, aes(x = L, y = blocking_pairs, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point()

n2 <- ggplot(newdf, aes(x = L, y = blocking_pairs, color = algorithm)) +
```
